limitations: Hero recommendation scores and rank-dependent ordering are synthetic examples, not measured performance.
No win rates, pick rates, samples, or live meta statistics are included.
Hero synergy previews use partial curated profiles, not a validated matchup model.
Item and skill plans use separate reviewed guides and verified game-data snapshots; see the full planner for their patch and limitations.
The bundled hero roster is a pinned identity snapshot, not a live feed.
